// The plugin's typed commands, name and description, registered at every session start
// (moved out of register.tsx's session.start hook, 0.4.67; the hook loops over this).

export const COMMANDS: readonly (readonly [string, string])[] = [
  ['bm-ids', 'Diagnostics: compare captured prompt ids with the ids drawn on screen'],
  ['bm-jump', 'Diagnostics: scroll to a prompt (first | last | N | r<N> | uuid)'],
  ['bm-pane', 'Diagnostics: open the prompts pane without the band; type a number and Enter to jump'],
  ['bm-marks', 'List the marks set in this conversation'],
  ['bm-delmarks', 'Delete marks: /bm-delmarks a b (letters), or /bm-delmarks all'],
  ['bm-env', 'Show the version, the session id and what has been captured'],
  ['bm-config', 'Show every setting, its value and where it came from'],
  ['bm-timeline', 'Diagnostics: show the last N plugin events (draws, appends, pane, store, toast, scroll)'],
  ['bm-sel', 'Diagnostics: show what Claude Code reports for your mouse selection'],
  ['bm-pin', 'Pin or unpin prompt #N in the prompts pane (no number: the newest)'],
  // Typed commands for the same actions as the band leader (they also work as
  // `command:<name>` keybindings, 2.1.290). A pane they open takes the keyboard from
  // an empty input box; over a draft they point to the band leader instead.
  ['bm-mark', 'Set a mark: opens the mark pane, then press a letter'],
  ['bm-goto', 'Jump to a mark: opens the jump pane, then press a letter'],
  ['bm-prompts', 'Jump to a prompt: opens the prompts pane, then type its number'],
  ['bm-read', 'Reading position: go there, or back to where you were'],
  ['bm-bookmarks', 'List the bookmarks of this conversation; type a number and Enter to jump'],
  ['bm-promote', 'Promote a mark into a bookmark: /bm-promote a'],
  ['bm-diag-keys', 'Diagnostics: log each keystroke in the input box (on | off | toggle)'],
  ['bm-debug', 'Echo the plugin\'s log lines into this conversation as dim rows (on | off | status), or turn debug channels on (channels | enable | disable); off by default'],
]

{
  "name": "bookmarks",
  "displayName": "Bookmarks",
  "version": "0.4.110",
  "description": "Bookmarks and vim-style marks inside Claude Code conversations: mark a line, jump back, keep a reading position, browse your prompts, and let Claude cite earlier places as clickable links.",
  "author": {
    "name": "DazzleML",
    "github": "https://github.com/DazzleML"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/DazzleML/claude-bookmarks",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/DazzleML/claude-bookmarks",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/DazzleML/claude-bookmarks/blob/main/PRIVACY.md",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/DazzleML/claude-bookmarks/issues",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/DazzleML/claude-bookmarks/tree/main/docs",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://github.com/DazzleML/claude-bookmarks/blob/main/LICENSE",
  "license": "GPL-3.0",
  "keywords": [
    "bookmarks",
    "pins",
    "marks",
    "vim-marks",
    "vim",
    "navigation",
    "conversation",
    "jump-to-message",
    "tui",
    "claude-code"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "listOpensAt": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Prompts list opens at",
      "description": "nearest: centred on the prompt nearest your view; newest: at the newest prompt",
      "default": "nearest",
      "options": [
        "nearest",
        "newest"
      ]
    },
    "followHere": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Prompts list follows the view",
      "description": "when-idle: slides to keep the yellow row showing unless you are typing a number; always; never",
      "default": "when-idle",
      "options": [
        "when-idle",
        "always",
        "never"
      ]
    },
    "closeShare": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Closeness for the earlier prompt",
      "description": "An earlier exchange is \"nearest\" while it holds at least this share of the screen lines the biggest one holds (0 to 1)",
      "default": 0.6,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1
    },
    "paneAfterJump": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Prompts or bookmarks list after you pick a row",
      "description": "close: clicking a row (or Enter on a number) jumps there and closes the list; stay: the list stays open for the next pick",
      "default": "close",
      "options": [
        "close",
        "stay"
      ]
    },
    "paneWhileTyping": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "A list while you type",
      "description": "stay: typing in the input box leaves an open list where it is; close: typing closes it",
      "default": "stay",
      "options": [
        "close",
        "stay"
      ]
    },
    "afterActionFocus": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Keyboard after an action",
      "description": "input: back to the input box once Claude Code allows a plugin to do it; band: stay in the band",
      "default": "input",
      "options": [
        "input",
        "band"
      ]
    },
    "debugDefault": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Debug echo by default",
      "description": "Whether the plugin's log lines are echoed into a conversation that has not chosen; /bm-debug decides per conversation",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "on"
      ]
    },
    "debugText": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Conversation text in the debug log",
      "description": "auto: off in an installed plugin, always in one loaded from a folder; off: log lines name places by id only; with-debug: they also quote the conversation while this conversation's debugging is on; always: they always quote it",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "off",
        "with-debug",
        "always"
      ]
    },
    "debugTextLength": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "How much text a debug line quotes",
      "description": "reference: a short excerpt, enough to find the place; full: the whole text",
      "default": "reference",
      "options": [
        "reference",
        "full"
      ]
    },
    "palette": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Colour overrides",
      "description": "JSON, e.g. {\"here\": {\"color\": \"cyan\"}, \"markBand\": {\"backgroundColor\": \"#203040\"}}. Roles: here, pinned, footnote, legend, mark, markBand, used, unused, unreached, emphasis, search. A colour is a theme key (warning, subtle, ...), a terminal colour name or #rrggbb; anything else is ignored",
      "default": ""
    },
    "footnotes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Footnotes in the prompts list",
      "description": "folded: a prompt with footnotes (your slash commands, ! shell commands, interruptions) shows an ellipsis, and . unfolds them; shown: always listed under their prompt; hidden: never listed",
      "default": "folded",
      "options": [
        "folded",
        "shown",
        "hidden"
      ]
    },
    "promptTextBudget": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Prompt text kept for the filter (bytes)",
      "description": "How much of your prompts the filter searches, across the conversation; 0 = unlimited (for machines with room to spare). The default keeps whole prompts in most conversations",
      "default": 2000000,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1000000000
    },
    "band": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "The band",
      "description": "full: the command field, the labelled commands and ? for the rest; field: the command field alone, one short row (the leader still lands there; ? shows the commands)",
      "default": "full",
      "options": [
        "full",
        "field"
      ]
    },
    "chords": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Chords on their own keybindings",
      "description": "on: mark, jump, prompts and read also answer the keybindings bound to their borrowed actions (docs: Optional fast keys); off: only the leader and the band's field",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "panes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Lists in a pane",
      "description": "on: the prompts and bookmarks lists open in a pane beside the conversation; off: p and b take a number in the band and jump, with no pane",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    }
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts"
}
